mechanism: Vitamin D enhances intestinal calcium absorption and bone mineralization, while vitamin K is essential for bone protein carboxylation; together they synergistically support bone health but excessive vitamin D may impair vitamin K-dependent protein function if calcium-phosphate balance is disrupted.
action: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and INR levels in patients on warfarin or other vitamin K antagonists; ensure adequate but not excessive vitamin D supplementation to maintain optimal bone metabolism without disrupting anticoagulation.
